text:
maria.chen: quick question — prepping to enable a per-customer flag for ACME (tenant_id=acme_corp). plan: staged canary (5% -> 20% -> 100%). who needs to sign off on the contract-entitlement gating piece?

aj.patel: i can take the sign-off for entitlements, fyi need to confirm that billing tags are set so usage maps back to the paid contract. did legal already toggle the allowlist?

maria.chen: legal confirmed terms yesterday but we don't yet have the allowlist created in the feature service. i'll create it but want to validate the rollout guardrails first.

samir.k: couple of guardrails to run through:
- audit log enabled for the flag update
- a canary alert if error rate > 1% or latency p50 regresses by >250ms
- automatic kill-switch to rollback to default false for tenant

ryan.oconnor: also add: rate-limit exemption only for existing VIP endpoints (not full throttle). and ensure tenant-based KV-cache warmup so first requests don't spike latency.

maria.chen: here's the flag payload i'll push to our toggle-api (pseudo):

```json
{
  "flag_key": "per_customer_feature_x",
  "tenant_id": "acme_corp",
  "enabled": false,
  "canary": {
    "phase_1_pct": 5,
    "phase_2_pct": 20,
    "phase_3_pct": 100,
    "auto_promote": false
  },
  "guardrails": {
    "error_rate_threshold": 0.01,
    "p50_latency_delta_ms": 250,
    "kill_switch_on_violation": true
  },
  "billing_tag": "acme_enterprise_2026"
}
```

aj.patel: looks good. for auto_promote=false we need a manual approve step in the rollout playbook. can you add a short note in the PR about who is the approver?

maria.chen: will do. proposing approvers: @aj.patel + @ryan.oconnor. i'll include the checklist in PR.

samir.k: ops note — when you enable phase_1 for 5% make sure the canary slice picks VIP and non-VIP traffic proportionally. we should exclude internal admin flows (token starts with admin-) from canary to avoid false positives.

maria.chen: good call. adding exclusion rule. also adding a warmup job:

```bash
# warmup newborn cache for acme_corp
./scripts/warmup_kv.sh --tenant acme_corp --endpoints /chat,/embed --concurrency 4
```

rollout-bot: [info] scheduled canary window: 2026-03-18T15:00Z -> 2026-03-18T16:00Z. monitoring hooks: metrics.acme_corp.per_customer_feature_x.*, alert: CANARY_GUARDRAIL_VIOLATION.

ryan.oconnor: one more: add a fallback model variant in routing (lower-cost quantized variant) if latency spikes or dedicated pool saturates — avoids full outage.

maria.chen: noted. final checklist before PR merge:
- [x] allowlist created in feature service
- [ ] billing tag verified by @aj.patel
- [ ] PR includes approvers and manual promote steps
- [ ] warmup job scheduled immediately before phase_1
- [ ] monitoring dashboard link in PR
- [ ] rollback play documented with steps and contact on-call

aj.patel: i'll validate billing tag by EOD. ping me in PR with the billing account id.

samir.k: i'll add the canary alert runbook link in the PR too.

maria.chen: thanks all — i'll open the PR now and tag you. plan to start phase_1 tomorrow morning if no blockers. :thumbsup:
